Class GraticuleRenderer

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.mapping.render.GraticuleRenderer
public final class GraticuleRenderer extends Object
Renders a map outline and latitude/longitude graticule lines for a given IMapProjection, with optional zoom-adaptive line spacing.

Adaptive spacing

In adaptive mode (the default), the graticule step is chosen from the geographic span currently visible in the viewport so that a roughly constant number of lines is shown regardless of zoom. The ideal step is snapped to a "nice" angular value drawn from NICE_STEPS_RAD (…30°, 15°, 10°, 5°, 2°, 1°, 30′, 15′, …) so that line positions and any labels remain on clean round values as the user zooms.

The visible span is measured empirically: points sampled within the projection's device-space clip bounds are inverse-projected back to (λ, φ) via MapContainer.localToLatLon(Point, Point2D.Double). Because this uses the projection's own inverse, it is correct for every projection — including the azimuthal ones (orthographic, Lambert) where a viewport corner may fall off the projected disk and invert to NaN. Such samples are skipped. Sampling the projection clip rather than the whole component also handles a fitted map with horizontal or vertical letterboxing.

Fixed spacing

When isAdaptive() is false, the renderer behaves exactly as before: it iterates the whole graticule using getLatitudeStepRad() and getLongitudeStepRad(). Those setters remain the source of the step in fixed mode and the fallback step in adaptive mode. Coordinate labels are available in both fixed and adaptive modes.

Rendering

Actual drawing is still fully delegated to the projection's IMapProjection.drawLatitudeLine(Graphics2D, IContainer, double) / IMapProjection.drawLongitudeLine(Graphics2D, IContainer, double), so graticule color, stroke, and curve shape continue to match the projection and its MapTheme. This class only decides which parallels and meridians to draw, and over what latitude/longitude extent.

    • setDrawLabels

      public void setDrawLabels(boolean drawLabels)
      Enables or disables coordinate labels along the viewport edges (e.g. "39°N", "132°E"). Labels are placed where each parallel/meridian enters the viewport in both fixed and adaptive spacing modes. They require the inverse + viewport that MapContainer supplies.
      Parameters:
      drawLabels - true to draw edge labels

    • render

      public void render(Graphics2D g2, IContainer container)
      Renders the map outline (if enabled) followed by all graticule lines.

      In fixed mode, parallels are drawn for φ ∈ [-π/2, +π/2] and meridians for λ ∈ [-π, +π] at the configured step. In adaptive mode, the visible (λ, φ) extent and a nice step are computed from the viewport, and only lines intersecting that extent are drawn (padded by one step so lines never pop in at the edges).

      Parameters:
      g2 - graphics context to draw into; must not be null
      container - container providing the world-to-local transform and, when adaptive, the inverse and viewport; must not be null
